label: H.Con.Res. 93
title: Providing for a joint session of Congress to receive a message from the President.

items.snippet: This concurrent resolution provides for a joint session of Congress on March 7, 2024, to receive a message from the President.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

S001176.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
S001176.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
S001176.note: No lobbying list to compare for this bill.
